summary: A student interrupts exam preparation to check whether an agency has found a substitute attendant.
realLife: Tomko described calling the agency repeatedly while studying because she would be the person left without help if it found no replacement.
gates: A canceled visit coincides with the student’s work for an upcoming exam.
inGame: needs: an agency call about a missed shift during exam preparation.

turns.what: The agency confirms coverage on the first call.
turns.writesBack: The student can return to studying.

turns.what: The agency promises to call back.
turns.writesBack: The student has a time to check again.
